bullets.text: Aggregate CR 93.4; Personal Lines CR under 94 (Direct 96, Agency near 92); Commercial Lines sub-91 with a 17-point monthly swing; February exceeded 96 target, March sub-92.

Companywide written premium grew just over 5%; property written premium increased 44% YOY through Progressive Home Advantage; Snapshot premium volume rose 31% supported by Direct channel new application growth.

Direct new applications grew 13% and Agency 2%; second half of February brought higher double-digit teen Direct growth before moderating; primary retention was slightly above year-ago levels for Direct, slightly below for Agency.

Winter weather brought a higher frequency of customer upsets, and Progressive maintained economic balance nicely; special lines hibernation during the quarter offered a short respite from normal loss costs over the year.

Added ~$150M in comprehensive investment income (1.4% total return); portfolio duration kept short at 1.7 years; net seller of corporate and non-treasury bonds as credit spreads narrowed, resisting reaching for yield.

Channel results diverged: Direct CR ran at 96 versus Agency near 92; Direct new applications grew 13% against Agency’s 2%; Snapshot saw strong Direct growth but disappointingly lower Agency acceptance.

Progressive Home Advantage property written premium grew 44% YOY; expanding multi-policy penetration rate served as a strong driver for auto policy life extension, with further details planned for May.

Snapshot premium volume rose 31% with 110 terabytes of vehicle-provided data available for analysis; mobile quoting and servicing performed very well, reflecting growing digital and mobile adoption by consumers.

With greater rate stability or smaller auto rate increases, primary retention returned to slightly above year-ago levels for Direct and slightly below for Agency, building stronger renewal business growth.

Noted a weaker economic environment than some expected; agency closures and extreme cold possibly affected consumer behavior; tax refund volume spikes also appeared out of sync with prior-year timing by about a week.
